title: 07 · Parlo: Italian lesson (phone, 390×844 @3x)
strengths: The exercise order is faithful to the shipped pattern: progress bar, prompt, character and bubble, answer line, word bank with empty slots, result sheet with Continue.
An own identity on top of the structure: an enamel moka-pot mascot, cobalt ink outlines, and a sunflower fill box marking the new word 'cornetto' in both the sentence and the answer tile.
Real lesson content: 'Vorrei un caffè e un cornetto', the gender hint '(m.)', an explanation on the result sheet.
slop_signals: Every word on screen is bold (Nunito 600-900, Fredoka 600-700): the prompt, the tiles, the sheet copy, the chips. Duolingo sets tiles and body at regular weight.
Confetti dots scattered on the result sheet and a dot grid on the page background: decoration twice.
The 'croissant (m.)' tooltip overlaps the top edge of the speech bubble instead of sitting clear of it.
A 2 px outline plus a hard bottom shadow on every tile, bubble, chip and button: the neo-brutalist tile look applied to all twenty-odd elements.
The mascot's blush cheeks and big round eyes are the generic 'cute app mascot' drawing.
fixes: Set tiles, sheet copy and the sentence at regular or medium weight; keep bold for the prompt and 'Perfetto!'.
Remove the confetti and the page dot grid.
Move the tooltip above the bubble with clear air, or inline the gender into the hint.
Give the hard shadow only to tappable tiles and the Continue button; set the bubble and chips flat.

references.what: Translate exercise with regular-weight tiles and a result sheet: the structure this piece follows.
Used tiles leave empty slots in the bank, so it never reflows.
'New word' chip and a dotted underline on the new word: one highlight device, not fill box plus chip plus bold.
Correct sheet with a meaning line and Continue; no confetti.
